shared.scope: Integrate liquidity reporting into the Northwind treasury dashboard: a data pipeline from the venue, a reporting dashboard, and a handover with documentation.

proposed_items.name: Data pipeline
proposed_items.deliverable: A job that writes hourly pool snapshots to the treasury's database, with tests.

proposed_items.name: Dashboard
proposed_items.deliverable: Spread, depth and volume panels for the NEAR/USDC pool, refreshed hourly.

proposed_items.name: Handover
proposed_items.deliverable: Runbook, access transfer and a one-hour walkthrough.

instructions: Three milestones of equal size are preferred. Delivery dates matter more than the last few dollars. Walk away rather than exceed the ceiling.
